_comment: HSP / EMPATH cluster illustration plan (2026-06-09 batch). Hero = 1 diffusion image per article (gemini-web, no text). Inline = LLM-planned SVG infographics, bilingual EN+ZH.

hero.prompt: A single unified photograph — one continuous scene, NOT a diptych, split frame, collage, or side-by-side panels. One solitary figure seen from behind sitting near a tall window at dusk, soft golden light falling across their shoulder while the room dissolves into deep indigo shadow; fine dust motes drift in the warm beam, the mood quiet, interior, and richly observant. Single full-frame atmospheric editorial photograph, deep indigo to near-black palette with warm gold light, soft focus, calm and contemplative, no text, no borders, no divider.
hero.altEn: A person sitting quietly by a window at dusk, bathed in soft gold light against deep indigo shadow, evoking a rich inner life
hero.altZh: 黄昏时分一个人静静坐在窗边，暖金色光线洒落，背景是深靛蓝的阴影，传达丰富的内在世界

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## The Highly Sensitive Person at a Glance
inline.titleEn: The Four Facets of High Sensitivity (DOES)

items.subEn: Takes input in and turns it over before responding
items.subZh: 接收信息后反复咀嚼，再做回应

items.subEn: Hits a sensory ceiling in loud, busy settings sooner
items.subZh: 在嘈杂喧闹的环境里更快达到感官上限

items.subEn: Strong feeling responses and quick attunement to others
items.subZh: 情绪反应强，并能迅速读懂他人

items.subEn: Notices small cues and details others filter out
items.subZh: 留意到别人忽略的细微线索与细节

inline.altEn: A row of the four facets of high sensitivity: depth of processing, overstimulation, emotional reactivity and empathy, and sensitivity to subtleties
inline.altZh: 高敏感四个面向并排展示：深度加工、容易过载、情绪反应与共情、感知细腻

hero.prompt: A close, tender still life of an open hand resting palm-up on soft linen near a window, a single thread of warm gold light catching the fingertips while the surrounding space sinks into deep indigo; the mood is attentive, gentle, and quietly perceptive, as if noticing something faint. Atmospheric editorial photography, deep indigo to near-black with warm gold accent light, soft shallow focus, calm and non-clinical, no text.
hero.altEn: An open hand resting palm-up in soft gold light against deep indigo, evoking quiet attentiveness and noticing the subtle
hero.altZh: 一只摊开的手掌在柔和金光中静静朝上，背景是深靛蓝，传达一种安静的觉察与对细微之物的留意

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## Signs of a Highly Sensitive Person at a Glance
inline.afterHeadingZh: ## Signs of a Highly Sensitive Person 速查表
inline.titleEn: Four Signs to Watch for Over Time
inline.titleZh: 值得长期留意的四个信号

items.subEn: Stimulation stacks up faster than usual
items.subZh: 刺激比一般人更快累积超载

items.subEn: Reads the feelings around you before they're spoken
items.subZh: 在别人开口前就读到周围的情绪

items.subEn: Turns each experience over slowly and thoroughly
items.subZh: 对每段经历反复、彻底地琢磨

items.subEn: Restores balance through quiet and solitude
items.subZh: 靠安静与独处来恢复平衡

inline.altEn: A row of four signs of a highly sensitive person to watch over time: sensory sensitivity, emotional attunement, deep processing, and need for recovery
inline.altZh: 高敏感人群值得长期留意的四个信号并排展示：感官敏锐、情绪共情、深度加工、需要恢复

Atmospheric editorial photography, deep indigo to near-black with warm gold light, soft focus, non-clinical and quiet, no text.
hero.altEn: Two soft pools of gold light side by side on deep indigo, gently overlapping where they meet, suggesting two distinct things that touch without merging
hero.altZh: 深靛蓝底色上两束柔和的金色光并排，在交界处轻轻交叠，象征两个相互接触却不混为一体的不同事物

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## Highly Sensitive Person vs Autism at a Glance
inline.afterHeadingZh: ## Highly Sensitive Person vs Autism 速查表
inline.titleEn: Highly Sensitive Person vs Autism: A Respectful Contrast
inline.titleZh: 高敏感与自闭症：审慎对照

linesEn: Temperament trait you self-describe; sensory overwhelm often eases with rest
Social situations are tiring but generally readable
linesZh: 可自我描述的气质特质；感官超载通常靠休息能缓解
社交虽累，但大体读得懂言外之意

linesEn: Neurodevelopmental diagnosis only a qualified professional can assess
Differences in social communication; a deeper need for predictable routine
linesZh: 需由合格专业人员评估的神经发展性诊断
社交沟通存在差异；对可预测的规律有更深的需求

inline.altEn: A two-column contrast of highly sensitive person as a self-described temperament trait versus autism as a professionally assessed clinical condition, not a self-diagnosis
inline.altZh: 两栏对照：高敏感是可自我描述的气质特质，自闭症是需专业评估的临床诊断，不可自我诊断

hero.altZh: 从侧台望去，一束暖金色聚光灯落在空舞台上，剧场隐入深靛蓝，传达登台面对强烈场面前那一刻的安静与内省

items.subEn: Takes input in slowly and reflects before reacting

items.subEn: Feels and mirrors moods with unusual intensity
items.subZh: 异常强烈地感受并映照他人情绪

items.subEn: Registers light, sound, and texture at low thresholds
items.subZh: 对光线、声音、质地的阈值更低

items.subEn: Picks up faint cues most people miss
items.subZh: 捕捉到多数人错过的微弱线索
